description: This file defines the class CustomReportUtils which provides utility methods for handling custom report queries, chart generation, date field checks, advanced search conditions, date axis labels, and entity type retrieval within the vtiger CRM system.

classes.name: CustomReportUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to generate reports, charts, and handle date and entity logic for vtiger CRM reports.

methods.name: getCustomReportsQuery
methods.description: Generates the SQL query for a custom report given its ID and optional filters.

methods.name: getReportChart
methods.description: Generates a chart (bar or pie) for a report based on the specified chart type.

methods.name: IsDateField
methods.description: Checks if a report column is of date type based on its details.

methods.name: getAdvanceSearchCondition
methods.description: Builds advanced search condition string based on field details, criteria, and value.

methods.name: getXAxisDateFieldValue
methods.description: Returns the formatted label for a date field value based on the specified criteria (year, month, quarter, etc.).

methods.name: getEntityTypeFromName
methods.description: Determines the entity type (module name) from an entity name by querying relevant tables.
